auth._evidence: Chatwoot is multi-tenant: an agent User belongs to one or more Accounts via AccountUser memberships; every API is scoped to Current.account. Login verifies on User (email + encrypted_password, app/controllers/api/v1/auth/sessions_controller.rb). The runtime cannot chain User->AccountUser->Account into the session, so $actor.id / $session.account_id is the User.id and the tenant is fixed by each call's account_id argument in an AccountUser membership guard.
